item.title: Arizona AG rejects Ticketmaster settlement, vows to continue legal battle
item.description: Arizona Attorney General Kris Mayes plans to continue the legal battle against Ticketmaster after the Justice Department announced a settlement in its antitrust lawsuit against it and its parent company Live Nation Entertainment on Monday.
